blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A general-purpose Vision-Language Model (VLM) has surpassed expert vision models in many domains such as object detection and video recognition. However, point correspondence is known to be challenging for VLMs since it goes beyond object-level recognition: it requires pixel-level localization of the same physical surface point across observations, even when appearance changes or the point disappears and later reappears. In this paper, we introduce AgenTAP, a VLM-based agent that directly predicts point coordinates and visibility and actively reasons over videos. Starting from its own estimate, the agent autonomously chooses what to inspect and uses the resulting evidence to verify point identity and refine its predictions. With GPT-6 Astra, it surpasses expert vision models in both point localization and visibility prediction, without correspondence-specific fine-tuning. We further use AgenTAP to re-identify physical points after disappearance and reconnect fragmented tracks, constructing EgoTAP-4D, a dataset of 3D point trajectories in long real-world egocentric videos. On sampled reappearing points, its predictions approach human agreement, and adding EgoTAP-4D to D4RT training improves average 3D tracking performance.
blocks.zh: 一个通用的视野语言模型(VLM)在许多领域,如物体检测和视频识别,已经超过了专家的视野模型. 然而,对于VLMs来说,点通信已知是具有挑战性的,因为它超越了对象级识别:它需要像素级本地化的同一物理表面点跨观测,即使外观变化或点消失后再出现. 在本文中,我们介绍了AgenTAP,这是一个基于VLM的代理,直接预测点坐标和能见度,以及视频上的积极原因. 从自己的估计开始,该剂自主选择检查什么,并使用由此而来的证据来验证点识别并完善其预测. 有了GPT-6 Astra,它在点定位和能见度预测上都超过了专家的视野模型,没有对应特定的微调. 我们进一步使用AgenTAP在消失后重新识别物理点并重新连接被分解的轨迹,构建了"EgoTAP-4D",这是一款由3D点轨迹组成的数据集,在长而真实的以自我为中心的视频中. 在抽样再现点上,其预测接近人类协议,并在D4RT培训中加入EgoTAP-4D,提高了平均3D跟踪性能.

blocks.en: 2 Introduction
blocks.zh: 2. 导言

blocks.en:
Visual correspondence is a fundamental capability in computer vision [ 51 , 19 , 24 ] .
This task is traditionally tackled in two lines of research.
Image matching [ 76 , 80 , 23 , 24 ] establishes correspondences across viewpoints, while point tracking [ 34 , 20 , 41 , 35 ] follows moving surfaces through time. Both rely on expert vision models trained to exploit appearance and temporal cues.
As a result, preserving point identity remains challenging when appearance changes dramatically or a point disappears and later reappears.
blocks.zh:
视觉通信是计算机视觉的一种基本能力[51,19,24].
这项任务传统上通过两条研究线来处理。
相匹配的图像[76, 80, 23, 24] 建立了跨视距的对应,而点跟踪[34, 20, 41, 35] 则跟随移动的表面穿越时间. 两者都依赖经过培训的专家愿景模型,以利用外观和时间提示。
因此,当外观发生巨大变化或某一点消失后再出现时,保留点身份仍然具有挑战性.

Here, AgenTAP locates a reappearing point that an expert vision model ( e.g. , AllTracker [ 35 ] ) incorrectly predicts as occluded.

blocks.en:
Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as powerful general-purpose systems for visual understanding, reasoning, and interaction, demonstrating broad capabilities in interpreting complex scenes [ 46 , 48 ] , solving visual reasoning problems [ 36 ] , grounding instructions [ 102 , 71 ] , and autonomously operating computers [ 92 , 28 ] .
However, visual correspondence remains an underexplored frontier for VLMs.
Their understanding of objects and spatial relationships could help preserve point identity across appearance changes, occlusion, and reappearance.
Our findings reveal a turning point: with agentic inference, GPT-6 Astra [ 58 ] becomes the first VLM in our evaluation to outperform expert vision models on the real-video benchmark.
Fable 5.2 [ 2 ] performs on par, while other VLMs have yet to cross this threshold.
We view this result as an early sign of a broader shift and expect more VLMs to follow as their capabilities advance.
This crossover in turn motivates a broader question:
blocks.zh:
视觉语言模型(VLMs)已作为强大的通用系统出现,用于视觉理解,推理和互动,展现出解释复杂场景的广泛能力[46,48],解决视觉推理问题[36],定位指令[102,71],自主操作计算机[92,28].
然而,视觉通信仍然是对甚高压材料的不足探索的前沿。
他们对物体和空间关系的了解有助于在外观变化、被隔离和重新出现之间保持点特征。
我们的研究结果揭示了一个转折点:通过推论推论,GPT-6 Astra[58] 成为我们评价中第一个在真实视频基准上超过专家愿景模型的VLM。
寓言5.2[2]按平方位进行,而其他VLM尚未越过这个阈值.
我们认为,这一结果是一个更广泛的转变的早期迹象,并期望随着其能力的发展,有更多的自愿和自愿参加。
这反过来又引发了一个更广泛的问题:

blocks.en: How far have general-purpose VLMs progressed toward reliable pixel-level physical correspondence?
blocks.zh: 通用的VLM向可靠的像素级物理通信发展了多远?

blocks.en:
We systematically investigate this question using TrackingBench (Sec. 4 ).
We curate 2,000 queries from 272 real-video clips across six domains, selecting visually diverse scenes and balancing visibility, motion, and frame gap.
An additional synthetic evaluation and independently annotated held-out videos probe distribution shifts and generalization.
Without tools, substantial gaps remain: VLMs fall far behind expert vision models on synthetic videos, and even GPT-6 Astra often identifies the right region without locating the exact point.
It places 87.1% of visible points within 16 pixels but only 23.8% within one pixel.
Other errors are semantically plausible but physically wrong, such as selecting the same part of a similar-looking instance, echoing prior findings on VLM hallucination [ 47 , 10 , 32 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们利用追踪奔驰(第4节)系统调查这个问题。
我们从272个真实录像片断中解析出2 000个来自六个领域的查询,选择各种视觉场景,平衡能见度、运动和框架差距。
额外的合成评估和独立附加说明的被搁置的视频探索了发行的转变和概括.
没有工具,仍然存在重大差距: VLM在合成视频上远远落后于专家的视觉模型,甚至GPT-6 Astra也经常在不定位准确点的情况下识别出正确的区域.
它将87.1%的可见点放入了16个像素之内,但只有一个像素之内只有23.8%.
其他错误在本质上是可信的,但在物理上是错误的,例如选择一个类似的例子的同一部分,与以前关于VLM幻觉的结论相呼应[47、10、32]。

blocks.en:
This gap reflects a limitation of direct prediction: a VLM reasons over two full images without the ability to inspect finer details or verify a candidate location.
We introduce AgenTAP , a VLM agent that turns an initial correspondence estimate into a prediction verified against visual evidence (Fig. 1 ; Sec. 5 ).
The VLM first predicts point coordinates and visibility before seeing optional proposals from expert vision models.
Its understanding of the scene then guides which magnified views, visual comparisons, and geometric measurements it requests, giving it access to the evidence needed for precise localization.
Expert outputs serve as additional evidence: the VLM can revise both coordinates and visibility and depart from every proposal, including by recovering a point that a tracker declares invisible.
Agentic inference improves correspondence for every backbone evaluated with AgenTAP , most at strict localization tolerances.
With GPT-6 Astra, AgenTAP surpasses all evaluated expert vision models on all four metrics under matched two-image and full-video input settings (Tab. 1 ).
Some GPT-6 Astra predictions locate the queried physical point more accurately than the reference human annotations [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh:
这一差距反映了直接预测的局限性:一个VLM在两个完整图像上的理由,无法检查更细细的细节或核实候选地点.
我们介绍AgenTAP,一种VLM剂,它把初步的函证估计变成一个经视觉证据核实的预测(图1;第5条)。
VLM首先预测了点坐标和能见度,然后才看到专家愿景模型的可选建议.
它对于场景的理解,然后引导它放大了视野,视觉比较,以及它所要求的几何测量,使它能获得精确定位所需的证据.
专家产出是补充证据:自愿清单可修改坐标和能见度,并偏离每项建议,包括恢复一个追踪者宣称看不见的点。
代理推论改进了AgenTAP所评价的每个骨干体的通信,大多是在严格的本地化能耐下.
借助GPT-6 Astra, AgenTAP在匹配的双图像和全视频输入设置下,在所有四个度量标准上超越了所有被评价的专家愿景模型(第1段)。
一些GPT-6 Astra预测比参考人类注释更准确地定位被询问的物理点[19].

blocks.en:
This also enables continuous point trajectories in long real-world videos.
Growing efforts in robot learning use point tracking for manipulation [ 90 ] and policy learning from egocentric human demonstrations [ 42 , 50 ] .
Reliable 3D trajectory annotations could turn egocentric recordings into beneficial supervision for learning how humans interact with the physical world.
However, existing trackers often fail to reconnect points after disappearance, fragmenting trajectories and limiting supervision for long-horizon interactions.
Our pipeline uses trackers to follow visible points and AgenTAP to recover the same physical points when they reappear, connecting their earlier and later tracks.
On a manually annotated sample of reappearing points, AgenTAP with GPT-6 Astra achieves 76.9 APD versus 40.1 for the best evaluated tracker (Tab. 5 ).
The resulting EgoTAP-4D provides 3D trajectory annotations for egocentric recordings substantially longer than the clips in existing real-video datasets (Sec. 7 ; Tab. 3 ).
Adding EgoTAP-4D to D4RT [ 100 ] training improves average 3D tracking performance (Tab. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
这也使得在长的活生生的视频中能够连续地点出轨.
在机器人学习操作使用点跟踪和从以自我为中心的人类演示中学习政策方面日益努力[42,50].
可靠的3D轨迹说明可以将以自我为中心的录音转化为有益的监督,以学习人类如何与物理世界互动。
然而,现有的跟踪器在消失后往往无法重新连接点,使轨迹被分解并限制了对长视距相互作用的监督.
我们的输油管使用跟踪器跟踪可见点,AgenTAP在重新出现时恢复相同的物理点,连接其早期和后期的轨迹.
在手动附加说明的再出点样本上,AgenTAP与GPT-6 Astra的比分是76.9 APD,对评价最佳的跟踪器是40.1(Tab. 5 )。
由此产生的EgoTAP-4D为以自我为中心的录音提供了3D轨迹说明,比现有真视频数据集(Sec. 7; Tab. 3)中的剪辑要长得多。
将EgoTAP-4D添加到D4RT[100]培训中,提高了平均3D跟踪性能(Tab. 4.

blocks.en:
In summary, our work makes three contributions:
(1) TrackingBench , a diverse cross-domain benchmark that characterizes the emerging crossover between general-purpose VLMs and expert vision models, together with the remaining gaps in localization, visibility, and generalization;
(2) AgenTAP , a VLM agent that improves correspondence across all evaluated backbones and, with GPT-6 Astra, surpasses all evaluated expert vision models on all four metrics; and
(3) EgoTAP-4D , a 3D point tracking dataset from long real-world videos that improves D4RT performance, together with its AgenTAP -based annotation pipeline.

blocks.en:
Visual correspondence. Image matching establishes correspondences across views using visual descriptors and spatial context [ 51 , 76 , 80 , 23 , 24 ] , and features of large vision models yield correspondences without matching-specific training [ 83 , 79 ] .
Point tracking additionally exploits temporal information to maintain physical surface-point identity and estimate visibility through motion and occlusion.
PIPs [ 34 ] and TAPIR [ 20 ] combine per-frame matching with temporal refinement, CoTracker3 [ 41 ] jointly updates tracks across points and time, and AllTracker [ 35 ] extends tracking to dense correspondences between a reference frame and each video frame.
TAPNext [ 105 , 39 ] casts tracking as next-token prediction, and Track-On [ 4 ] tracks online with a memory.
Pseudo-labels from real videos improve generalization [ 21 , 41 ] , and a learned verifier can select reliable ones among tracker predictions [ 5 ] .
Benchmarks on long egocentric and dynamic videos show that points leaving and re-entering the view remain a key failure mode [ 15 , 18 ] .
In AgenTAP , the VLM forms its own correspondence hypothesis, actively selects image regions and visual operations to test it, and revises its prediction. This verification happens at inference and re-identifies points after they reappear, which we use to build EgoTAP-4D .
blocks.zh:
视觉通信. 图像比对建立了使用视觉描述符和空间上下文的跨视图对应[51,76,80,23,24],而大型视觉模型的特征产生对应的对应,而不进行匹配特定训练[83,79].
点跟踪还利用了时间信息来保持物理地表点身份并通过运动和隔离来估计能见度.
PIPs [34]和TAPIR [20] 结合了每帧匹配的时间精度,CoTracker 3 [41] 联合更新了穿越点和时间的音轨,而AllTracker [35] 扩展了对一个参考帧和每个视频帧之间的密集通信的跟踪.
TAPNext [105,39] 将跟踪设定为下接的预测,而Track-On [4] 有内存的轨道在线.
来自真实视频的Pseudo-label改善了通俗化[21,41],一个有学问的核查者可以在跟踪器预测中选择可靠的. [5].
以长的自负为中心且充满活力的视频基准显示,指出和再入景点仍然是关键故障模式[15,18].
在AgenTAP中,VLM形成了自己的对应假说,积极选择图像区域和可视操作进行测试,并修改了预测. 这种核实是在推断和重新出现后重新识别的点,我们用来建造EgoTAP-4D。

blocks.en:
Spatial grounding in VLMs. VLMs ground language to image regions [ 102 , 71 ] and predict points for object and affordance localization [ 17 , 99 ] .
Molmo2 [ 13 ] extends pointing to video and object tracking, while MolmoPoint [ 12 ] improves localization through dedicated grounding tokens.
Evaluation spans language-guided pointing [ 11 ] , candidate correspondence selection [ 26 , 98 ] , and semantic matching across object instances [ 22 ] .
CrossPoint-Bench [ 94 ] evaluates physical point correspondence and visibility in indoor scenes, scoring pointing by whether a prediction falls within the target mask.
Its CroPond model is fine-tuned on geometrically generated correspondence pairs, whereas AgenTAP reaches precise correspondence with general-purpose VLMs through agentic inference alone.
blocks.zh:
空间定位在VLMs. VLMs地语到图像区域[102.,71],并预测对象和支付力局部化的分数[17.,99].
Molmo2 [13] 延伸指向视频和物体跟踪,而MolmoPoint [12] 通过专用地标来改进本地化.
评价跨越语言指导指向[11],候选人函证选择[26,98],以及不同对象的语义相匹配[22]。
CrossPoint-Bench [94] 在室内场景中评价物理点的相通和能见度,以预测是否属于目标口罩来评分.
其CroPond模型在几何生成的对应对上进行了微调,而AgenTAP仅通过代理推论就与通用VLM实现精确的对应.

blocks.en:
Agentic visual reasoning. Visual programming connects language reasoning to executable vision tools [ 82 , 33 ] , while Visual Sketchpad [ 36 ] enables iterative reasoning with visual feedback.
V* [ 96 ] , ZoomEye [ 78 ] , and DeepEyes [ 104 ] make visual inspection adaptive through search, zooming, or learned policies.
ACTrack [ 7 ] coordinates expert vision models for object tracking, invoking a VLM under persistent disagreement to arbitrate between candidate boxes.
AgentSTAR [ 53 ] combines VLM reasoning with numerical optimization for shape tracking: the VLM guides pose searches and inspects renderings, while an optimizer produces precise poses.
In AgenTAP , the VLM itself predicts and revises the point’s coordinates and visibility. Tools only supply evidence, so its answer can depart from any proposal.
blocks.zh:
代理视觉推理. 视觉编程将语言推理连接到可执行的视觉工具上[82,33],而Visual Sketchpad [36] 则能够用视觉反馈进行迭代推理.
V* [96],ZomEye [78],和DeepEyes [104] 通过搜索,缩放或学习到的政策,使视觉检查适应性.
ACTRACK [7] 协调用于物体跟踪的专家视觉模型,在对候选框之间的仲裁一直存在分歧的情况下引用了VLM.
AgentSTAR [53] 结合了VLM推理和数字优化来进行形状跟踪:VLM向导摆出搜索并检查渲染,而优化者则产生精确的姿势.
在AgenTAP中,VLM本身预测并修改了点的坐标和能见度. 工具只提供证据,所以其答案可以背离任何建议.

blocks.en: 4.1 Problem Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 问题设置

blocks.en:
Each query consists of a source image I s I_{s} , a marked visible point p s p_{s} , and an unmarked target image I t I_{t} .
A method predicts whether the same physical surface point is visible in I t I_{t} , giving a visibility label v ^ t ∈ { 0 , 1 } \widehat{v}_{t}\in\{0,1\} .
If predicted visible, it also returns the point’s 2D image coordinates p ^ t \widehat{p}_{t} . Otherwise, no position is required.
Both the camera and surface may move, so the task requires locating the same surface point, not merely recognizing the same object or part.
A point is invisible if it is occluded, lies outside the image, or belongs to a surface facing away from the camera, even when the object itself remains visible.
blocks.zh:
每个查询都包含一个源图像 I s I_{s},一个被标记的可见点 p s_{s},和一个没有标记的目标图像 I t I_{t}.
一种方法预测在 It I_{t} 中同一物理表面点是否可见, 给出了能见度标签 v ^ t { { 0, 1}\ globalhat{v}_{t}\in\{0, 1} 。
如果预测可见, 它也会返回该点的 2D 图像坐标 p^ t\ gladhat{p} 。 否则,不需要任何职位。
相机和地表都可能移动,所以任务需要定位同一个地表点,而不仅仅是识别同一个物体或部分.
如果一个点被封住,位于图像外,或者属于从相机外向外的地表,即使物体本身仍然可见,也是不可见的.

blocks.en: 4.2 Benchmark Curation
blocks.zh: 4.2 基准校正

blocks.en:
Source videos. We pool clips from public point-tracking benchmarks [ 19 , 31 , 45 , 6 , 15 , 73 , 62 , 18 , 91 , 90 , 106 , 49 ] to cover diverse scenes and motions.
Uniform sampling would overrepresent larger sources and their recurring recording conditions.
We therefore allocate source quotas based on visual diversity measured with DINOv3 embeddings [ 79 ] .
Within each source, we cluster clips by appearance, motion, and visibility, then select those nearest the cluster centers.
blocks.zh:
出处视频. 我们从公共点追踪基准[19、31、45、6、15、73、62、18、91、90、106、49]汇集剪辑,以涵盖各种场景和动议。
统一取样会过多地代表更大的来源及其反复出现的记录条件。
因此,我们根据以DINOv3嵌入测量的视觉多样性分配源配额[79]。
在每一个来源中,我们通过外观,运动和能见度来进行集群剪辑,然后选择离集群中心最近的那些.

blocks.en:
Benchmark queries. We construct a pool of 14,896 queries: 12,496 from real videos and 2,400 from synthetic videos.
For each annotated track, we pair its first visible observation and, when available, one randomly sampled later visible observation with later labeled target frames.
We include invisible targets, exclude missing annotations, and balance displacement, frame gap, and target visibility.
The synthetic queries are used only for real–synthetic comparisons in the analysis.
To reduce the computational cost and runtime of evaluation, we select 2,000 queries from the real-video pool as the main benchmark, stratified by domain, target visibility, whole-track motion, and frame gap.
Across evaluated VLMs, scores and rankings on the 2,000-query benchmark closely agree with those on the full 12,496-query real-video pool.
blocks.zh:
基准查询。 我们建造了一个14,896个查询库:12,496个来自真视频,2,400个来自合成视频。
对于每个附加说明的音轨,我们配对其第一个可见的观察,并在有可用时,随机抽取一个后期可见的观察,并配以后期被标记的目标帧.
我们包括隐形目标,排除缺失说明,平衡流离失所、框架差距和目标可见度。
合成查询只用于分析中的真实-合成比较。
为了减少计算成本和评价的运行时间,我们从真视频集合中选择了2,000个查询作为主要基准,按域分级,目标能见度,全轨运动,以及帧差距.
在整个评估的VLM中,2000克里基准的得分和排名与12 496克里真视频池的得分和排名非常一致。

blocks.en:
Held-out annotations. We independently capture and annotate 15 in-the-wild videos in three stages:
(1) an annotator selects a visible source point and labels its position or invisibility in target frames;
(2) a second annotator labels the same frames without seeing the first answers;
(3) a third annotator labels disputed targets without seeing either earlier answer.
Two labels agree if both mark the point invisible or both mark it visible within four pixels at the evaluation scale.
For disputed targets, the third label and an agreeing earlier label determine the final annotation.
We average agreeing visible coordinates and exclude unresolved targets and unusable tracks, retaining 1,814 queries. Videos and labels remain hidden.
blocks.zh:
被搁置的说明。 我们独立地捕捉和记录了 15个模糊的视频分三个阶段:
(1) 注释员选择一个可见源点,并标出其在目标框中的位置或隐形性;
( 二 ) 第二 个 注释 , 给 同一 框架 贴上 标签 , 不 看到 第一批 答案 ;
(3) 第三个注释者将有争议的目标贴上标签,但没有看到更早的答复。
如果两个标签都标出隐形点,或者两个标签都标出在评价尺度的四个像素内可见.
对于有争议的目标,第三个标签和一个商定的更早的标签决定最后的说明。
我们平均商定可见坐标,排除未解决的目标和无法使用的轨道,保留1 814个查询。 视频和标签仍然被隐藏。

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价议定书

blocks.en:
All main comparisons and ablations use the same 2,000 queries.
Two-image methods receive only the source and target images, while full-video methods can also access other frames.
In direct prediction, a VLM reasons over the inputs and answers in a single call without tools, whereas agents may inspect images and use tools over multiple steps.
Missing or invalid answers count as failures.
blocks.zh:
所有主要的比较和拼接都使用相同的2000个查询.
二相相法只接收出源和靶相法,而全相法也可以访问其他帧.
在直接预测中,一个无工具的单调中输入和回答的VLM理由,而代理商可以检查图像,并使用工具超过多步骤.
缺少或无效的答案算作失败 。

blocks.en: Figure 3: AgenTAP . (1) Initial prediction: the VLM agent inspects both views and records its own prediction. (2) Optional expert consultation: expert vision models propose candidate locations. (3) Iterative visual verification: the agent selects visual tools to test its hypothesis, revises the point’s location and visibility, and re-checks as needed.
blocks.zh: 图3:AgenTAP (1)初步预测:VLM剂检查观点并记录自己的预测. (2)可选专家磋商:专家愿景模型提出候选地点. (3)迭代可视化验证:代理商选择可视化工具来测试其假设,修改点的位置和能见度,并根据需要重新检查.

blocks.en:
Metrics. Following TAP-Vid [ 19 ] , we evaluate on a normalized 256 × 256 256\times 256 grid.
We report APD for localization accuracy, AJ for joint localization and visibility, and OA for visibility accuracy.
APD and AJ are averaged over distance thresholds of 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 pixels.
Unlike TAP-Vid’s position-only accuracy, our APD additionally requires a visible prediction.
EPE averages position errors on ground-truth-visible targets, capped at 32 pixels.
All metrics are pooled across queries. Curation, annotation, and evaluation details appear in supplementary Sec. A .
blocks.zh:
度量衡. 继TAP-Vid [19],我们评价一个正态的256×256256\times 256网格.
我们向APD报告本地化准确度,AJ报告联合本地化和能见度,OA报告能见度准确度。
APD和AJ的平均距离阈值为1,2,4,8和16像素.
与TAP-Vid的仅定位精度不同,我们的APD还需要一个可见的预测.
EPE平均在地上可见目标的位置出错,上限为32像素.
所有衡量标准都通过查询汇总。 说明、注释和评价细节见补充Sec.A.。

blocks.en: 5 AgenTAP
blocks.zh: 5个AgenTAP

blocks.en: 5.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 5.1 概览

blocks.en:
Human visual reasoning draws on an understanding of surfaces and motion to guide where to look and which details to compare.
Motivated by this interaction between reasoning and observation, AgenTAP lets a VLM independently predict point coordinates and visibility, then actively test its prediction (Fig. 3 ).
The VLM selects visual tools (Sec. 5.2 ) to inspect image regions, compare local details, and refine the point’s location and visibility.
Each observation informs both the prediction and what to inspect next.
Expert vision models optionally provide candidate locations for verification, while the VLM determines the final correspondence.
The procedure requires no correspondence-specific VLM fine-tuning .
blocks.zh:
人类的视觉推理借鉴了对表面和运动的理解来引导到哪里去取景,以及哪些细节可以比较.
基于推理和观察之间的这种相互作用,AgenTAP让一个VLM独立预测点坐标和能见度,然后积极测试它的预测(图3.
VLM选择可视化工具(Sec 5.2)来检查图像区域,比较本地细节,并完善点的位置和能见度.
每项观察都为预测和下一步检查的内容提供信息。
专家愿景模型可选地提供可供核查的候选地点,而VLM则决定最终对应.
该程序不要求针对通信的VLM微调。

Overall columns evaluate all queries together rather than averaging the six domains, and domain columns omit EPE. Higher is better except for EPE. HR: high resolution. Subscripts give each agent’s change from the same VLM’s two-image direct prediction, which is also the reference for full-video agents. Green marks an improvement and gray a decline. blocks.en: 5.2 Visual Tools
blocks.zh: 5.2 视觉工具

blocks.en: The VLM receives descriptions of the tools in Fig. 3 and chooses which to invoke and their inputs.
blocks.zh: VLM接收图3中对工具的描述,并选择要引用哪些工具及其输入.

blocks.en:
Image inspection. With view , the VLM chooses regions and scales to inspect scene context, texture, and boundaries, zooming in or out and enhancing contrast as needed.
Grids and point overlays use original image coordinates.
The marks tool returns source-marker coordinates.
blocks.zh:
图像检查。 视此,VLM选择区域和尺度来检查场景上下文,纹理和边界,并按需要放大或缩小并增强对比.
网格和点上覆盖使用原始图像坐标.
标记工具返回源标记坐标 。

blocks.en:
Correspondence checking. The check tool displays source and candidate target crops side by side and as an overlay.
Landmarks and boundaries help assess surface identity and spatial offsets.
Rechecking revised coordinates tests whether refinement preserves the queried surface point.
blocks.zh:
信件检查 检查工具显示源和候选目标作物并肩并肩并肩并肩。
地标和边界有助于评估地表特征和空间抵消。
重新检查修改后的坐标测试是否保留了被询问的地表点 。

blocks.en:
Coordinate estimation. The VLM can call fit with landmark correspondences it identifies in the source and target images.
The tool fits an affine transformation or homography to these pairs and maps the source point to a target coordinate.
This estimate assumes that the landmarks and query point share a local transformation.
Fitting residuals and a visualization help the VLM assess the resulting estimate.
The match tool uses template matching or SIFT [ 51 ] within a VLM-selected target region, returning candidates for further visual verification .
blocks.zh:
坐标估算. VLM可以用它在源和目标图像中识别的地标通信调用fit.
该工具与这些对子相匹配的同源变换或同位素,并绘制出源指向目标坐标的地图.
这一估算假设地标和查询点共享局部变换.
接合残基和可视化有助于VLM评估由此产生的估计.
匹配工具在一个 VLM 选择的目标区域内使用模板匹配或 SIFT [51],返回候选人进行进一步的视觉验证. .

blocks.en:
Temporal inspection. With full-video input, frame shows VLM-selected intermediate frames and regions.
Surface motion and orientation help resolve point identity and visibility.
Supplementary Sec. B provides tool descriptions and additional visualization options .
blocks.zh:
临时检查。 通过全视频输入,帧显示VLM所选择的中间帧和区域.
地表运动和取向有助于解决地点身份和能见度.
补充秘书。 B提供了工具描述和额外的可视化选项.

blocks.en: 5.3 Agentic Inference
blocks.zh: 5.3 代理人推论

blocks.en: Initial prediction. In Stage 1 of Fig. 3 , the agent inspects source and target overviews, identifies the queried surface, and records a position or an invisible decision. This prediction precedes expert proposals and intermediate-frame inspection, preserving the agent’s independent estimate.
blocks.zh: 初步预测. 在图3的第一阶段,代理人检查来源和目标概览,确定被询问的表面,并记录一个位置或无形的决定。 这一预测先于专家建议和中期检查,保留代理人的独立估计。

blocks.en:
Optional expert consultation. When enabled, expert proposals provide alternative correspondence hypotheses for visual verification (Stage 2 of Fig. 3 ).
The VLM may accept, refine, or reject these proposals, and its final answer need not match any supplied candidate .
blocks.zh:
可选专家咨询。 如果启用,专家建议为视觉核查提供了替代函证假设(图3第2段)。
自愿多数派可以接受、完善或拒绝这些提议,其最后答案不需要与任何提供的候选人相匹配。

blocks.en:
Iterative visual verification. The VLM tests correspondence hypotheses against visual evidence, choosing subsequent inspections based on what it observes.
The prompt specifies the verification objective and available tools, and the VLM selects each operation and its inputs.
blocks.zh:
活性视觉验证. VLM对照视觉证据对函证假说进行测试,根据观察结果选择后续检查.
提示中指定了核查目标和可用工具,VLM选择了每个操作及其输入.

blocks.en:
For a visible candidate, the agent compares its position relative to nearby landmarks with that of the source point, as in Stage 3 of Fig. 3 .
If the surface correspondence appears correct but the position remains uncertain, the VLM can adjust the coordinate directly or use fit with landmark correspondences.
Crops and geometric estimates retain native image coordinates.
A location obtained from a magnified view or landmark fit can then be marked on the target and checked again.
In the illustrated example, a nearby side marking guides the correction, which the agent then re-checks .
blocks.zh:
对于一个显眼的候选者,该代理将其相对于相邻地标的地位与源点的地位相提并论,如图3第3阶段.
如果表面的通信似乎正确,但位置仍然不确定,VLM可以直接调整坐标或与地标通信相适应的使用.
作物和几何估计保留了本土图像坐标。
然后可以在目标上标出一个从放大视图或地标相配得到的地点并再次检查。
在示例中,附近的一面标记指导改正,然后由代理人重新检查。

blocks.en:
If the visual evidence instead suggests the wrong object, part, or surface, the VLM can choose to revisit the source image and search for a different correspondence.
The marked source point remains fixed, and the VLM revises its interpretation of the surface carrying that point.
Position and visibility are reconsidered together: further inspection may recover a missed point or reveal that the queried surface is hidden despite a plausible match on a visible surface.
blocks.zh:
如果视觉证据相反地暗示了错误的对象,部分,或表面,VLM可以选择重温源图像并搜索不同的对应.
标记出源点仍然固定,VLM修改了对携带该点的地表的解释.
对位置和能见度一并重新考虑:进一步检查可能会发现漏掉的一点,或者表明被询问的表面是隐蔽的,尽管在可见的表面有可信的匹配。

blocks.en:
The agent returns a target coordinate or an invisible decision after verification.
Supplementary Sec. B details the protocol, prompts, and example agent sessions .
blocks.zh:
代理在验证后返回目标坐标或无形决定.
补充秘书。 B 详细列出协议、提示和代理会话示例 。

blocks.en: 6 Experiments
blocks.zh: 6个实验

blocks.en:
Setup. We compare AgenTAP with direct prediction by the same VLM, in which the VLM reasons over the two images and answers without tools, and with five expert vision models: RoMa v2 [ 24 ] , AllTracker [ 35 ] , CoTracker3 [ 41 ] , BootsTAPIR [ 21 ] , and TAPNext++ [ 39 ] .
With two images, AgenTAP receives RoMa v2 and AllTracker proposals. With full video, it receives high-resolution AllTracker proposals and intermediate frames.
Settings, prompts, and computational costs are in supplementary Sec. B .
blocks.zh:
设相. 我们比较了AgenTAP与同一VLM的直接预测,其中VLM在没有工具的情况下对两个图像和答案进行了解释,还比较了五个专家视觉模型:RoMa v2 [24],AllTracker [35],CoTracker [41],BootstAPIR [21],和TAPNext++ [39].
AgenTAP通过两个图像接收RoMa v2和AllTracker建议. 它通过全视频接收高分辨率的AllTracker建议和中间帧.
设置、提示和计算费用为补充Sec.B。

blocks.en: 6.1 Direct Prediction
blocks.zh: 6.1 直接预测

blocks.en:
Visibility and localization. VLMs that localize the point better also judge more reliably whether it is still visible (Fig. 5 ), suggesting that both draw on the same scene understanding.
Visibility is the harder half.
VLMs rarely call a point hidden: most mark close to nine in ten queries visible, although one in five targets is hidden.
Answering “visible” every time would already reach 79.0 OA, and only six VLMs in Fig. 5 beat this by more than two points.
The two skills can still come apart: Inkling, Inkling-Small, and Qwen3.5-9B reach about this OA yet rarely find the exact point, whereas Molmo2, which sees the video, localizes better than its visibility decisions suggest.
The strongest VLM, GPT-6 Astra, already beats every two-image expert model in APD and OA by direct prediction, though not yet in AJ (Tab. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
显相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 VLM将点点定位得更好,也更可靠地判断点是否仍然可见(图5),说明两者都借鉴了同一场景的理解.
可见是难分之分.
VLMs很少调用隐藏点:在十个查询中大多数接近9个的标记可见,虽然五个目标中有一个被隐藏.
每次回答“可见”的问题,就已经达到79.0 OA,在Fig只有6个VLM。 5以2分多击败了这个.
两种技能仍然可以分道扬镳:"墨克林"(Inkling),"墨克林-斯小"(Inkling-Small)和"Qun3.5-9B"(Quen3.5-9B)触及到这个OA,然而很少找到确切的点,而"Molmo2"(Molmo2)在观看这段视频时,比其能见度决定暗示的更能本地化.
最强的VLM(GPT-6 Astra)已经通过直接预测击败APD和OA中的每个双相专家模型,虽然还没有在AJ(Tab. 1.

blocks.en:
Model scaling. Within the Qwen3.5 dense family, larger models do better, although APD plateaus from 9B to 27B (Fig. 4 a).
Across families, Gemma-4-31B-it beats the much larger Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, so total parameter count alone does not predict correspondence ability.
blocks.zh:
模型缩放。 在Quen3.5稠密的家族中,更大的模型表现得更好,尽管APD高地从9B到27B(图4 a).
跨家庭,Gemma-4-31B-it击败了更大的Quen3.5-122B-A10B,因此仅是总参数数并不能预测通信能力.

blocks.en:
Held-out generalization. Across models, rankings on independently annotated held-out videos closely match those on TrackingBench (Fig. 4 b).
This agreement supports the benchmark as a reliable evaluation of correspondence ability and eases concerns that strong performance reflects data leakage. TrackingBench is also harder: nine of the eleven models score lower on it than on the held-out set.
blocks.zh:
被淘汰的概括。 在整个模型中,独立附加说明的被搁置视频的排名与跟踪奔驰视频的排名(图4b)相近。
该协议支持该基准是对通信能力的可靠评价,并缓解了强烈性能反映数据泄漏的担忧. 跟踪 座椅也比较难:11个模型中有9个得分低于被搁置的组合.

blocks.en: 6.2 Agentic Inference
blocks.zh: 6.2 代理推论

blocks.en: AgenTAP gives the same VLMs visual tools: they still reason, but can now inspect, compare, and verify their answers.
blocks.zh: AgenTAP提供相同的VLMs可视工具:它们仍然有道理,但现在可以检查,比较,验证它们的答案.

blocks.en:
AgenTAP helps across backbones. AgenTAP improves precision for all backbones (Tab. 1 ).
Seven of the eight then beat every two-image expert model in APD, and GPT-6 Astra, from only two frames, beats every full-video tracker in APD and OA.
Given the same input as the expert models, AgenTAP with GPT-6 Astra beats all of them on all four metrics, including high-resolution AllTracker, whose own predictions it receives as proposals. Claude Fable 5.2 gives the best APD and EPE in both settings.
Applied frame by frame, AgenTAP turns two-frame correspondences into trajectories that follow the ground-truth motion and keeps points that AllTracker loses (Fig. 7 ).
blocks.zh:
AgenTAP帮助跨骨干。 AgenTAP提高所有骨干精度(第1段).
8个中的7个随后在APD中击败了每个双相专家模型,而GPT-6 Astra则只从两个帧中击败了APD和OA中每个全相声追踪器.
鉴于与专家模型相同的投入,AgenTAP与GPT-6 Astra在包括高分辨率AllTracker在内的所有四个度量标准上都击败了它们,而AgenTAP作为建议收到了它们自己的预测. Claude Fable 5.2在两种场合都给出了最好的APD和EPE.
AgenTAP按帧应用框架,将两帧对应物转换为跟随地心-真实运动并保持AllTracker所失去的分数的轨迹(图7.

blocks.en: AgenTAP narrows the backbone gap. AgenTAP helps weaker backbones more. Among the six strongest, it adds 30.8 APD to the weakest, Inkling 2 Small, but only 12.0 to the strongest, GPT-6 Astra. Their gap shrinks from 26.0 APD under direct prediction to 7.3 with AgenTAP : given tools, a much weaker VLM nearly catches up.
blocks.zh: AgenTAP缩小了骨干差距. AgenTAP帮助更弱的骨干. 在最强的六人中,它为最弱的"Inkling 2 Small"增加了30.8APD,但为最强的"GPT-6 Astra"只增加了12.0. 他们的差距从直接预测的26.0APD缩小到7.3,

blocks.en:
Localization precision. Without tools, GPT-6 Astra already places 87.1% of visible points within 16 pixels, but only 23.8% within one pixel (Fig. 4 d): it finds the right region, not the exact pixel. AgenTAP mainly fixes the last few pixels.
Its improvement is small at 16 pixels (+3.9) but large at one- and two-pixel thresholds (+16.4 and +18.9), as magnified views and side-by-side checks reveal details that are lost when the VLM reasons over the full images alone.
blocks.zh:
本地化精度. 没有工具,GPT-6 Astra已经将87.1%的可见点放入了16个像素中,但只把23.8%放入了一个像素(图4d):它找到正确的区域,而不是精确的像素. AgenTAP主要修复后几个像素.
它的改进小于16像素(+3.9),但大于一等和二等分阈值(+16.4和+18.9),因为放大了的视图和并边检查揭示出当VLM原因单独超过完整图像时丢失的细节.

blocks.en:
Temporal separation. All methods lose accuracy as the frame gap grows, but high-resolution AllTracker loses the most, so AgenTAP ’s lead over it widens at longer gaps (Fig. 4 c).
When a hidden point reappears in the target frame, full-video trackers call it invisible about three times as often as two-image AgenTAP (supplementary Sec. C ).
blocks.zh:
暂时分离 随着帧间隙的增大,所有方法都失去了准确性,但高分辨的AllTracker损失最多,因此AgenTAP的领先优势在更长的间隙会扩大(图4 c.
当一个隐藏点在目标框中再现时,全视频跟踪器将其称为"隐形"大约是"双相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相

blocks.en:
Robustness of AgenTAP . AgenTAP fixes many wrong initial answers while rarely breaking correct ones.
From each session’s first prediction, made before any expert proposal, to its final answer, corrections by AgenTAP with GPT-6 Astra far outnumber regressions at every threshold, mostly by moving a visible point to the right location (Fig. 4 f).
blocks.zh:
AgenTAP的强健性. AgenTAP 修正了许多错误的初始答案,同时很少打破正确的答案.
从每次会议在专家建议之前所作的第一次预测到最后的答案,AgenTAP对GPT-6 Astra的更正远远超过每个阈值的回归数,主要是将一个可见点移到正确的位置(图4f)。

blocks.en:
Agentic tool use. Agentic tool use helps every model.
A fixed zoom harness, which shows the VLM preset close-ups around its direct prediction, barely helps.
Letting the VLM choose its own inspections instead, still without proposals, improves both backbones and already lets GPT-6 Astra beat every two-image expert model on all metrics.
blocks.zh:
代理工具的使用. 代理工具的使用帮助了每个模型.
固定的缩放带,显示VLM在直接预测周围预设了特写,几乎没有帮助.
让虚拟LM选择自己的检查,仍然没有建议,改进了主干,并且已经让GPT-6 Astra在所有度量衡上击败每个双像专家模型.

blocks.en:
Expert proposals. Expert proposals improve the weaker backbone, Inkling 2 Small, more than GPT-6 Astra.
Both models usually retain a supplied proposal, but GPT-6 Astra is more reliable when revising them: its changes usually improve localization, whereas Inkling 2 Small’s help in 53.5% of cases and hurt in 38.7%.
To assess whether the agents go beyond proposal selection, we evaluate an oracle that chooses the better-localized RoMa v2 or AllTracker proposal for each point while using AllTracker’s visibility.
This oracle reaches 59.7 APD.
GPT-6 Astra exceeds it even without proposals, demonstrating strong independent correspondence ability.
Inkling 2 Small exceeds it only with proposals, indicating greater reliance on external candidates.
Even with the true visibility, it reaches only 53.1 AJ and 67.3 APD, below AgenTAP ’s 54.9 and 71.4.
blocks.zh:
专家建议。 专家建议改进了较弱的骨干"墨林2""小",比"GPT-6 Astra"还要多.
两个模型通常都保留一个提供的建议,但GPT-6 Astra在修订时更加可靠:其变化通常会改善本地化,而Inkling 2 Small的帮助则在53.5%的病例中被提供,而伤害则在38.7%.
为了评估代理商是否超越提案选择,我们评价一个预告片,在使用AllTracker的能见度的同时,为每个点选择更本地化的RoMa v2或AllTracker提案.
这个先知达到了59.7APD.
GPT-6 Astra甚至没有建议就超越了它,显示出强大的独立通信能力.
墨水2 Small只用提案来超过它,表明更多地依赖外部候选人.
即使有了真正的能见度,它也只达到53.1 AJ和67.3 APD,低于AgenTAP的54.9和71.4.

blocks.en:
Temporal evidence. The VLM can exploit video, mainly to judge whether a point is visible: with two images, AgenTAP with GPT-6 Astra adds 12.0 APD and 0.8 OA over direct prediction, and with the full video OA reaches 88.2.
With the full video, AgenTAP improves both backbones and, with GPT-6 Astra, surpasses high-resolution AllTracker, whose predictions it receives as proposals.
When both call a point visible, AgenTAP almost always keeps the tracker’s position. Where they disagree about visibility, AgenTAP is right four times out of five, mostly on visible points the tracker marks invisible.
The frames between the endpoints add 1.6 AJ and 1.1 OA (supplementary Sec. C.3 ).

临时证据。 VLM可以利用视频,主要用来判断一个点是否可见: 有两幅图像,配有GPT-6 Astra的AgenTAP增加了12.0 APD和0.8 OA相较于直接预测,而完整的视频OA达到88.2.
AgenTAP凭借全程视频改进了两条主干线,并随着GPT-6 Astra超越了高分辨的AllTracker,其预测作为建议收到.
AgenTAP几乎总是保持追踪器的位置。 当他们对能见度有分歧时,AgenTAP在五分之四中是正确的,大多在可见点上,追踪器会标记出无形.

Real vs. synthetic. With two-image input, GPT-6 Astra’s direct predictions outperform AllTracker in several real-video domains.
On synthetic videos, however, AllTracker clearly outperforms GPT-6 Astra and Opus 5.5 (Fig. 4 e).

blocks.en:
Egocentric video is a stress test for correspondence: as the wearer moves and handles objects, surfaces leave the view, disappear behind hands, and return seconds later.
Expert vision models often lose such points (Sec. 6.2 ), and existing real-video 3D point tracking datasets span only a few seconds per clip (Tab. 3 ). EgoTAP-4D fills this gap with 3D point trajectories over long egocentric recordings, using a VLM to recover each point when it reappears.

专家视野模型往往会失去这种分数(Sec 6.2),而现有的真视频三维点跟踪数据集每段只跨出几秒(Tab. 3. EgoTAP-4D以3D点轨迹来填补这个空白,凌驾于长自负心的录音上,使用VLM来恢复再现时的每个点.

blocks.en:
We use different tools for different parts of the annotation process (Fig. 6 ).
We annotate 3,740 recordings from Xperience-10M [ 75 ] and 1,659 from Ego-Exo4D [ 30 ] , 5,399 videos and 297.2 h in total, with an average duration of 198 s.
Depth and camera poses map observations from all frames into a shared metric coordinate system.
After a per-recording calibration of the Xperience-10M stereo depth, its median error stays within ± \pm 1% up to 3 m (supplementary Sec. D.2.1 ). Geometry handles static surfaces: GMOS object masks [ 97 ] separate them from moving ones, and every point on the fused static surface projects into every frame, so static points can be sampled anywhere, at any density. A tracker handles moving surfaces while they stay in view: AllTracker [ 35 ] follows them and bridges gaps of up to a second, and motion capture provides hands where available. A VLM handles what both miss.
When an object returns after at least three seconds, AgenTAP with GPT-6 Astra locates 10 of its points from before the gap in a frame after the return.
We accept a prediction only if it lies on the same object, has valid depth, and is not on a hand, and an AllTracker cross-check on a second post-return frame rejects inconsistent matches.
Of 14,091 reappearance image pairs with 10 points each, 7,057 pass filtering, and 23,072 of their 70,570 query points pass these checks and enter the dataset (supplementary Sec. D.2.4 ). Fig. 8 shows trajectories from six recordings.

Annotations approach human agreement. Expert vision models fail to re-identify reappearing points, so we evaluate this step directly.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en:
Finding the same physical point across views and time is a longstanding problem in computer vision.
We approached it as visual reasoning: with AgenTAP , a general-purpose VLM forms a hypothesis about the point, inspects the images to test it, and revises its answer.
With GPT-6 Astra, AgenTAP surpasses expert vision models on TrackingBench , especially on reappearing points.
This shows that VLM reasoning has advanced from objects to individual pixels.
We used AgenTAP to reconnect reappearing points in long egocentric videos for EgoTAP-4D .
Applied at scale, it can provide 3D training data for expert vision models and for robots that learn from human demonstrations.
We hope the community will build on agentic tracking to develop models with stronger spatial intelligence.
blocks.zh:
在各种观点和时间中找到同样的物理点是计算机视觉中长期存在的问题。
我们把它当作视觉推理:用AgenTAP,一个通用的VLM对这个点形成一个假设,检查图像来测试它,修正它的答案.
随着GPT-6 Astra, AgenTAP超越了追踪奔驰的专家愿景模型,
这表明VLM推理已经从对象发展到单个像素.
我们用AgenTAP重新连接了 EgoTAP-4D 中以自负为中心的视频中的重现点。
它可以大规模应用,为专家视觉模型和从人类演示中学习的机器人提供3D培训数据.
我们希望社区将利用代理跟踪,开发空间智能更强的模型。

blocks.en: Appendix A TrackingBench
blocks.zh: 附录A 追踪奔驰

blocks.en: TrackingBench is built in three steps. First, we select video clips from public point-tracking benchmarks (Sec. A.1 ). Second, we build a pool of 14,896 queries from their released tracks (Sec. A.2 ). Third, we sample the 2,000-query main benchmark from the 12,496 real-video queries of this pool (Sec. A.3 ). Because public videos may appear in VLM training data, we also annotate 1,814 held-out queries on 15 new videos (Sec. A.4 ). Sec. A.5 details the evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 追踪奔驰分三步建设. 首先,我们从公共点追踪基准(Sec.A.1.)中选择视频剪辑。 第二,我们从他们释放的音轨(Sec.A.2.)中建立了14 896个查询库。 第三,我们从这个集合的12 496个真视频查询中(Sec.A.3.)抽取了2000克的主要基准。 由于公共视频可能出现在VLM培训数据中,我们还对15个新视频(Sec. A. 4)提出了1 814个搁置的询问。 第A.5条详细规定了评价协议。

blocks.en: A.1 Source Videos
blocks.zh: A.1 源视频

blocks.en: We draw 7,172 candidate clips from public point-tracking benchmarks (Tab. S1 ), allocate a quota to each source, and select representative clips within each source.
blocks.zh: 我们从公共的分数跟踪基准(Tab.S1)中抽取7 172个候选剪辑,为每个来源分配配额,并在每个来源中选择有代表性的剪辑。

blocks.en: We represent each clip by the mean DINOv3 ViT-L [ 79 ] features of 16 frames, normalized to unit length. A greedy covering procedure [ 27 ] counts how many representative clips are needed to cover each source within a distance of 0.7. Each quota grows with the square root of this count, so visually diverse sources receive more clips while large sources do not dominate. Every source contributes at least eight clips when available, and DriveTrack and ADT together contribute at most 50.
blocks.zh: 我们以16个帧的DINov3 VIT-L[79]个平均特性来代表每个片段,正常为单位长度. 一个贪婪的覆盖程序[27]计算出需要多少具有代表性的剪辑才能在0.7的距离内覆盖每个来源. 每个配额都随着这个计数的平方根而增长,因此视觉多样的源得到更多的剪辑而大源并不占主导地位. 每个来源提供至少8个片段,DriveTrack和ADT一起提供最多50个片段。

blocks.en: Within each source, we cluster the appearance features together with five tracking attributes: camera rotation, visible fraction, points per labeled frame, clip length, and dynamic fraction. The attributes add variation in tracking conditions that appearance alone misses. We log-transform points per labeled frame and clip length, standardize all five attributes, scale them by 0.5, and concatenate them with the appearance features. With a fixed seed, we then select the unused clip nearest to each cluster center (Fig. S1 ).
blocks.zh: 在每个来源中,我们把外观特征与五个跟踪属性组合在一起:相机旋转,可见分数,每个被标记框的分数,剪接长度,和动态分数. 属性增加了光是外观缺失的跟踪条件的差异. 我们每个标签框和剪接长度的对数转换点, 将所有五个属性标准化, 缩放为 0.5, 并将其与外观特征相配合。 有了固定的种子,我们再选择离每个集群中心最近的未使用的剪辑(图. S1.).

blocks.en: We select 300 clips, remove the 8 STIR clips because their landmarks lack verified temporal identities [ 77 ] , and add 20 TAP-Vid Kubric validation clips for synthetic analysis [ 19 , 31 ] , giving 312 clips. The 28 Kubric and RGB-Stacking clips are synthetic and stay out of the main benchmark.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了300个剪辑,删除了8个STIR剪辑,因为它们的地标缺乏经过核实的时间特征[77],并增加了20个TAP-Vid Kubric验证剪辑用于合成分析[19,31],给出了312个剪辑. 28个库布里克和RGB-Stacking剪辑是合成的并远离了主基准.

blocks.en: A.2 Query Pool
blocks.zh: A.2 查询池

blocks.en: Each query pairs a reference observation of a released track with a target frame, as described in Sec. 4.2 . Query points thus inherit their identities from the released tracks, as in TAP-Vid [ 19 ] . To avoid concentrating on nearby frames and nearly static points, we sample reference–target pairs across strata of displacement, frame gap, target visibility, and intermediate invisibility. The smallest-displacement stratum receives half weight. At most four targets per reference and 40 track–reference pairs per clip limit repeated queries. This yields 14,896 queries from 5,958 tracks, 12,496 of them from real videos and 2,400 from synthetic ones.
blocks.zh: 每个查询对一个释放出有目标框架的轨道的参考观测,如Sec所描述. 4.2 (英语). 因此,查询点从释放的音轨中继承其身份,如TAP-Vid [19]. 为了避免集中在附近的框架和近乎静态的点上,我们把参考物—跨流离失所阶层的目标对、框架差距、目标能见度和中间隐形物作为样本。 最小的迁移层得到一半的重量。 每个参考文献最多4个指标,每个短片40个跟踪参考对限制了重复查询。 共收到来自5 958个音轨的14 896个查询,其中12 496个来自真实视频,2 400个来自合成视频。

blocks.en: A.3 Main Benchmark
blocks.zh: A.3 主要基准

blocks.en: To reduce the computational cost of evaluation, all main comparisons use 2,000 queries sampled from the 12,496 real-video queries. We fix the sampling rule before evaluation, then check that the sample represents the pool and examine its labels.
blocks.zh: 为了降低评价的计算成本,所有主要比较都使用从12 496个真视频查询中抽取的2000个查询。 我们先确定采样规则然后进行评估,然后检查样品是否代表了池并检查其标签.

blocks.en: We stratify by content domain, target visibility, whole-track motion (static or dynamic, defined below), and frame gap (1–16, 17–64, 65–256, and more than 256 frames). Each of the 85 nonempty strata receives a share of the 2,000 queries proportional to its size in the pool. We sample uniformly within each stratum with seed 0. The rule and the seed were fixed before any score on the benchmark was observed.
blocks.zh: 我们按内容域、目标能见度、全轨运动(静态或动态,以下定义)以及框架差距(1-16、17-64、65-256和超过256个框架)来划分。 85个非空层中,每个层都收到与池中大小成正比的2 000个查询。 我们在每个地层内用种子统一取样 零点 该规则和种子在基准上的任何分数被遵守之前已经确定。

blocks.en: The benchmark covers 272 clips from 13 real-video sources and six content domains: everyday activities, sports and performances, robotic manipulation, driving and street scenes, animals and nature, and biomedical scenes. Domains describe scene content, so one source can span several domains. The benchmark has 1,579 visible and 421 invisible targets, and 1,296 queries on dynamic tracks and 704 on static ones. A track is dynamic if any of its visible annotations lies on an object that GMOS [ 97 ] identifies as moving, and we review these labels manually. The label thus describes the whole track rather than the queried interval. Frame gaps count frames rather than seconds, since frame rates differ across sources.
blocks.zh: 基准涵盖来自13个真视频源和6个内容领域的272个剪辑:日常活动、体育和表演、机器人操纵、驾驶和街头场景、动物和自然以及生物医学场景。 域名描述场景内容,因此一个源可以跨越多个域. 该基准有1 579个可见和421个无形目标,1 296个查询在动态轨道上,704个查询在静态轨道上。 一个音轨是动态的,如果它的任何可见的注释都位于GMOS[97]识别为正在移动的对象上,我们手动审查这些标签. 因此,标签描述了整个音轨,而不是被询问的时间间隔。 框架差距计数框架而非秒数,因为框架比率因来源而异。

blocks.en: The benchmark matches the pool in domain, frame gap, visibility, and motion (Fig. S2 ). Scores match as well. Across the 29 systems scored on both sets, APD rankings on the benchmark and the pool have Kendall τ = 0.995 \tau=0.995 , and APD differs by at most 1.1 points (Fig. S3 ). Models run only on the benchmark, including all agents, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Fable 5.2, and Inkling 2 Small, have no pool scores and are not included. Over 200 alternative sampling seeds, the 95% range of a system’s APD stays within ± 1.3 \pm 1.3 points of its pool score for the median system and within ± 2.3 \pm 2.3 points for every system.
blocks.zh: 基准与域、框间隙、能见度和运动(图S2)的池相匹配。 得分也相应. 29个系统在两套中都得分,APD在基准和游泳池上的排名有肯德尔(Kendall)\=0.995\tau=0.995,APD在最多1.1分(图S3)上的差异. 模型只运行在基准上,包括所有代理,GPT-6.1 Sol,克洛德·寓言 5.2,和Inkling 2 Small,没有池分,也不包括. 超过200个替代采样种子,一个系统的APD的95%范围停留在中位数系统的 ± 1.3 \pm 1.3 分内,每个系统的 ± 2.3 \pm 2.3 分内。

blocks.en: We keep the released point identities and visibility labels, accounting for source-specific media alignment and invalid frames. Label quality varies across sources, and RoboTrack Real marks its annotations as unreviewed [ 73 ] . Three annotators reviewed 81 queries on which the free-form GPT-6.1 Sol agent (Sec. C.3 ) missed by 16 pixels or more, one annotator per query. They judged 19 released labels wrong and 30 targets impossible to label from the two images.
blocks.zh: 我们保留释放出点的身份和能见度标签,计算出特定源的媒体对接和无效帧. 标签的质量因来源而异,RoboTrack Real将其说明标记为未经审查[73]. 3个注释员审查了81个查询,免费格式的GPT-6.1 Sol代理(Sec. C.3)错过了16个像素或以上,每个查询一个注释员. 他们判断19个发布的标签错误,30个目标无法从两个图像中标出标签.

blocks.en: A separate review of disagreements between AgenTAP with GPT-6 Astra and the released annotations reveals cases where the label appears wrong (Fig. S4 ). In the apple sequence, the label moves to a neighboring apple, while AgenTAP stays on the queried one. In the other two sequences, the labels mark visible points as occluded, while AgenTAP continues to locate them. In the vehicle sequence, it follows the point to the image border and marks it invisible once it leaves the frame. We evaluate against the released labels without modification, so these predictions are scored as errors.
blocks.zh: 对AgenTAP与GPT-6 Astra之间的分歧和发布的说明进行单独审查后发现标签出现错误的情况(图S4 )。 在苹果序列中,标签会移动到相邻的苹果上,而AgenTAP则会留在被询问的苹果上. 在另外两个序列中,标签将可见点标为被吞噬点,而AgenTAP则继续定位. 在行车序列中,它跟随到图像边框的点并标记出离框后会隐形. 我们不作修改地对照发布的标签来评价,所以这些预测被评为出错.

blocks.en: A.4 Held-out Annotations
blocks.zh: A.4 搁置说明

blocks.en: To check that results on TrackingBench do not reflect data leakage, we capture 15 new videos, totaling 33.7 minutes of animals and human activities, and annotate them in the three stages of Sec. 4.2 . Four annotators take part, and three of them contribute videos.
blocks.zh: 为了检查追踪奔驰的结果 不反映数据泄露, 我们捕捉了15个新视频, 总计33.7分钟的动物和人类活动, 4名注释员参加,其中3名提供视频。

blocks.en: The uploader selects a reference frame and a physical surface point, then labels the point in about 20 target frames before and after the reference. A visible point is clicked, and a hidden one is marked occluded or outside the image. This gives 96 tracks and 1,870 targets.
blocks.zh: 上传者选择一个参考框架和一个物理表面点,然后在参考前后在约20个目标框中标出该点. 一个可见点被点击,一个被隐藏的被标记为被覆盖或图像外. 这使96个轨道和1,870个目标。

blocks.en: A second annotator labels the same targets without seeing the first answers and may reject an unsuitable reference point. One rejection removes 19 targets. The two annotators agree on 89.6% of the remaining 1,851 targets. Where both mark the point visible, their median distance is 0.42 pixels on the 256 × 256 256\times 256 grid.
blocks.zh: 第二位注释员在没有看到第一批答案的情况下给同一目标贴上标签,并可能拒绝不适当的参考点. 一次拒绝 清除19个目标。 两位注释员就其余1,851个指标中的89.6%达成一致. 在两者都标出可见点的地方,它们的中位相距为256×256256\times 256网格上的0.42像素.

blocks.en: A third annotator labels the 192 disputed targets without seeing either earlier answer, and the final label comes from the third label and the earlier label it agrees with (Sec. 4.2 ). We exclude 18 unresolved targets and a second unsuitable reference point with its 19 targets. The final set has 1,814 queries on 94 tracks, with 1,364 visible targets and 631 targets before the reference. The median gap between reference and target is 5.5 seconds, and the 90th percentile is 59.7 seconds. The videos and labels remain hidden. Fig. 4 b of the main paper compares direct prediction on this set with the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 第三个注释者给192个有争议目标贴上标签,没有看到更早的答案,最后的标签来自第三个标签和它同意的更早的标签(Sec.4.2.). 我们排除了18个未了目标,排除了第二个不适当的参照点,其中列有19个目标。 最终集有94道的1,814个查询,参考前有1,364个明显目标与631个目标. 参考与目标相差中位数为5.5秒,第90分数为59.7秒. 录像和标签仍然被隐藏。 发相. 主要文件第4b段将本套直接预测与基准进行比较。

blocks.en: RoMa v2 [ 24 ] runs at its default precise setting and predicts the point visible when its overlap probability is at least 0.05. CoTracker3 [ 41 ] runs offline at 384 × 512 384\times 512 and predicts the point visible when its visibility is at least 0.6. blocks.en: Each query runs in its own container, which holds only the images of the query and the tool, with no network access and no dataset or ground-truth annotations. The agent calls the tool from the command line (Fig. S5 ). The tools of Sec. 5.2 are commands of this one program, zoom.py . Two further commands, commit and frames , run the staged protocol and list the intermediate frames. Most commands return an image, which we call a view, overlaid with a coordinate grid in native image pixels (a 0–1000 grid for the two locally served models of Sec. B.3 ). view can mark a candidate position on the target or enhance contrast, and check shows the reference point next to a candidate position, side by side, blended, and as a checkerboard. fit and match return proposed coordinates that the agent can inspect, revise, or discard.

blocks.en: B.2 Protocol
blocks.zh: B.2 议定书

blocks.en: The protocol follows the three stages of Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh: 议定书遵循图3的三个阶段。

blocks.en: The agent opens at most two overviews, each covering at least a third of the image in both dimensions, and records its initial prediction with commit .
blocks.zh: 该剂最多打开两个概览,每个概览至少涵盖两个维度上图像的三分之一,并以承诺记录其初步预测.

blocks.en: If the initial prediction is visible, commit returns one view that shows it next to the RoMa v2 and AllTracker proposals. An expert’s proposal is shown only if that expert predicts the point visible and inside the image. The agent receives no other information about the experts’ visibility decisions. After an invisible initial prediction, no proposals are shown.
blocks.zh: 如果初始预测可见, 承诺返回一个视图, 显示在 RoMa v2 和 AllTracker 提案旁边 。 只有在专家预测可见点和图像内部时,才显示专家的建议。 代理人没有收到其他关于专家知名度决定的信息。 在无形的初步预测之后,没有显示任何建议。

blocks.en: The agent then has five more views to verify its answer and may change both the position and the visibility. These limits count only views rendered by the tool, and the agent can also open the two original images. The final answer is a target position or an invisible decision, and a missing or invalid answer counts as a failure (Sec. A.5 ).
blocks.zh: 然后,代理人又有5个观点来验证其答案,可能会改变立场和能见度. 这些限制只计算工具所给出的视图,代理也可以打开两个原始图像. 最后的答案是目标位置或无形的决定,缺失或无效的答案算作失败(Sec. A.5.).

blocks.en: The prompt is the agent instructions (Fig. S6 ) followed by the task text of the query (Fig. S7 ). Direct prediction receives only the task text.
blocks.zh: 提示是代理指令(图 S6 ),然后是查询的任务文本(图 S7 ). 直接预测只收到任务文本.

blocks.en: With full video, the RoMa v2 proposal stays the same, the AllTracker proposal comes from its high-resolution prediction on the whole video, and after the initial prediction the agent can also inspect intermediate frames with frames and frame . These views count toward the five verification views. The intermediate-frame ablation of Sec. C.3 keeps this proposal but shows only the two endpoint images.
blocks.zh: 有了完整的视频,RoMa v2提案保持不变,AllTracker提案来自其对整个视频的高分辨率预测,在初始预测后,代理商也可以用帧和帧来检查中间帧. . 这些观点与5个核查观点一致。 Sec. C.3的中间框缩放保留了这个提议,但只显示两个端点图像.

blocks.en: B.4 Runtime and Computational Cost
blocks.zh: B.4 运行时间和计算费用

blocks.en: Tab. S4 reports tokens and time per query for GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, and Inkling 2 Small. GPT-6 Astra opens on average 4.3 views per two-image session and 4.5 with video access, and GPT-6.1 Sol opens 5.2. The expert proposals add less than 7 GPU-seconds per query and are not included. For the free-form GPT-6.1 Sol agent of Sec. C.4.1 , sharing a session among 16 points lowers the mean tokens per query by 56–70%. Sessions are independent, so they run in parallel. With 8 concurrent sessions, GPT-6 Astra with video access answers all 2,000 queries in 4.0 hours, about 500 queries per hour. While this computational cost is high, distilling the agent into an efficient model, such as a compact VLM or AllTracker, is a natural next step and could enable real-time tracking with AgenTAP .
blocks.zh: Tab. S4报告GPT-6.1 Sol,GPT-6 Astra和Inkling 2 Small的每个查询符和时间. GPT-6 Astra平均每双相会开启4.3个取景,4.5带视频访问,而GPT-6.1 Sol则开启5.2. 专家建议每个查询增加不到7个GPU秒,不包括在内。 对于Sec.C.4.1的免费式GPT-6.1 Sol代理,在16分之间共享一个会话,将每个查询的平均会标降低56-70%. 会话是独立的,所以它们并行运行. 有8个平行的课,GPT-6 Astra有视频访问功能在4.0小时内回答了所有2 000个询问,大约每小时500个询问. 虽然这种计算成本很高,但将该剂蒸馏成一个高效的模型,如紧凑的VLM或AllTracker,是自然的下一步,可以实现与AgenTAP的实时跟踪.

blocks.en: A visible target is reappearing if an intermediate annotation marks it invisible, and continuously visible if every intermediate frame is labeled visible. Of the 1,579 visible targets, 933 are continuously visible, 456 reappear, and 190 have unknown histories and are left out of this split. On the 456 reappearing targets, the five full-video trackers (CoTracker3, BootsTAPIR, TAPNext++, and AllTracker at both resolutions) predict 15–28% invisible, 22% on average, against 8% for two-image AgenTAP with GPT-6 Astra. Since APD and AJ count these predictions as misses, AgenTAP leads the trackers by 7.6–15.7 APD and 3.1–11.6 AJ. During continuous visibility, high-resolution AllTracker and two-image AgenTAP have similar APD (75.4 and 75.9), while the tracker leads in AJ (67.7 and 65.7) and one-pixel accuracy (49.3 and 46.8).

blocks.en: Full-video AgenTAP improves reappearance correspondence further. On all 456 reappearing targets it reaches 67.4 APD and 57.7 AJ, against 57.5 and 52.1 for high-resolution AllTracker, and predicts 38 of them invisible (with one invalid answer), where the tracker rejects 124. Over the whole benchmark, the two differ in visibility on 270 queries, and the agent is right on 215, 192 of them visible targets that the tracker marks invisible. Where both predict visible, their positions agree within one pixel on the 256 × 256 256\times 256 grid in 1,388 of 1,445 cases.
blocks.zh: 全面视频AgenTAP进一步改善了复出通信。 在所有456个重新出现的目标上,它分别达到67.4 APD和57.7 AJ,而高分辨率AllTracker为57.5和52.1,并预测其中38个是隐形的(有一个无效的答案),其中跟踪者拒绝124. 在整个基准中,两者在270个查询上的能见度不同,代理在215上是正确的,其中192个可见目标被跟踪者标记为隐形. 在两种预测都可见的情况下,它们在1,445个案例中的1,388个案例中,在256×256分256分秒的网格上在一个像素范围内达成一致.

blocks.en: C.4 Scaling Reference Points and Target Frames
blocks.zh: C.4 扩大参照点和目标框架

blocks.en: The benchmark results of the main paper ask about one query point in one target frame per session. Here we test whether sessions that share several query points in the reference frame, or several target frames of one query point, keep this accuracy, and how their token usage changes.
blocks.zh: 主论文的基准结果每会话询问一个目标框架中的一个查询点。 在这里,我们测试在参考框中共享数个查询点的会话,或者一个查询点的数个目标帧,是否保持这一准确性,以及它们的符号使用的变化.

blocks.en: We construct a separate query pool for multi-point and multi-frame tracking from the clips and ground-truth tracks of TrackingBench . For each clip, we select one reference frame and 16 points that remain visible at target frames 18, 36, and 54 frames later. We choose points farthest-first, keeping them at least 5% of the image width apart so that their markers do not overlap. The pool has three subsets: points with displacement, points with negligible displacement, and clips containing both. Tab. S8 reports their sizes, displacement thresholds, median displacements, and source datasets. Each query pairs a point with a target frame. Both studies use this query pool, grouping points or target frames into sessions. Their sessions use the free-form agent of Tab. S7 , not the staged protocol of Sec. B.2 : the agent calls the tool’s commands in any order, without commit or expert proposals.
blocks.zh: 我们从追踪奔驰的短片和地上真相轨迹中,为多点和多帧跟踪建造一个单独的查询池。 对于每个片段,我们选择一个参考框架和16个点,在目标框架18、36和54之后仍然可见。 我们选择最远的点,把它们至少保持图像宽度的5%,这样它们的标记就不会重叠. 游泳池有三个子集:有流离失所的分点,有可忽略不计的流离失所分点,以及包含两者的片段. 标签。 S8报告了它们的大小、迁移阈值、中位迁移和源数据集。 每个查询对一有目标框架的点. 这两项研究都使用这个查询池,将点或目标框分组成会话. 他们的会话使用Tab的免费形式代理. S7, 而不是Sec. B.2的预设协议 : 代理以任何顺序调用工具的命令, 无需承诺或专家建议 。

blocks.en: C.4.2 Multi-frame Tracking
blocks.zh: C.4.2 多帧跟踪

blocks.en: Having examined scaling the number of query points in the reference frame, we now turn to scaling the number of target frames for a single query point. We evaluate whether accuracy on a fixed target frame is preserved as more targets are requested. We also compare predicting target frames together or separately on the same point–frame pairs to assess the benefit of processing target frames together. A session with one target frame shows the reference and target images, and a session with several target frames shows the reference with all of its target frames.
blocks.zh: 在审查了参考框架的查询点数量之后,我们现在转向一个查询点的目标框架数量。 我们评价是否随着要求更多的目标而保留了固定目标框架的准确性。 我们还在同一个点-框对上一起或单独对目标框进行比较,以评估将目标框一起处理的好处。 一个带有一个目标框架的会话显示参考和目标图像,一个带有几个目标框架的会话显示其所有目标框架的参考.

blocks.en: We examine whether requesting additional targets affects accuracy on the first target frame. We evaluate GPT-6.1 Sol with a single query point. Sessions request the target at gap 18, add the target at gap 36 in the two-frame setting, and also include gap 54 in the three-frame setting. Accuracy on the same first target stays at or above the single-frame baseline across all three subsets (Tab. S11 , left). Points with displacement benefit most from adding the second target. Adding the third changes APD by less than one point in every subset.
blocks.zh: 我们审查要求增加目标是否会影响第一个目标框架的准确性。 我们用一个单一的查询点来评估GPT-6.1 Sol。 会话请求在相差18分时设定目标,在相差36分时添加相差36分的目标,并在相差3分时也包含相差54分. 同一第一个目标的精确度在所有三个子集(Tab.S11,左)的单一框架基线上或以上。 增加第二个目标最有利于流离失所问题。 添加第三个更改 APD 在每个子集中小于一分 。

blocks.en: Using the same token accounting as in the multi-point study, we measure usage per answer, where each answer corresponds to one point at one target frame (Tab. S12 ). Tokens per answer still fall from two to three frames in every subset.

blocks.en: D.1 Dataset Sources
blocks.zh: D.1 数据集来源

blocks.en: We combine Xperience-10M [ 75 ] and Ego-Exo4D [ 30 ] , processing both at 10 fps. From Xperience-10M, we use 3,740 episodes totaling 253.1 h, with the left camera view, calibrated stereo depth, SLAM camera poses, and hand motion capture where available. From Ego-Exo4D, we use 1,659 takes totaling 44.1 h, which provide no hand motion capture. In total, EgoTAP-4D contains 5,399 videos totaling 297.2 h, with an average duration of 198 s.
blocks.zh: 我们结合了Xperience-10M [75]和Ego-Exo4D [30],在10 fps同时处理. 从Xperience-10M开始,我们使用3,740集,共253.1h,以左相机取景,校准立体声深度,SLAM相机姿势,并有可用的手动捕捉. 从"Ego-Exo4D"中,我们使用1,659取出共44.1h,不提供手动捕捉. EgoTAP-4D总共收录了5,399个视频,共计297.2h,平均持续时间为198 s.

blocks.en: D.2 Annotation Pipeline
blocks.zh: D.2 注解管道

blocks.en: We annotate each recording in five steps (Fig. 6 ). We first recover metric depth and camera poses for every frame. We then label each object as static or moving in every frame and use these labels to build trajectories separately for static surfaces, moving objects, and hands. Next, we reconnect the tracks of objects that leave the field of view and return. Finally, we lift the trajectories to 3D, remove unreliable 3D positions, and store the annotations.
blocks.zh: 我们分五个步骤(图6)对每个记录进行注释。 我们首先恢复每个帧的度量深度和相机 然后我们把每个物体标为静态或移动在每一个框中,并使用这些标签来分别构建静态表面,移动物体,和手的轨迹. 接下来,我们重新连接离开视野和返回的物体的轨道。 最后,我们把轨迹提升到3D,去掉不可靠的3D位置,并存储注释.

blocks.en: We downsample the original 20 fps rectified left video to 10 fps. For camera poses, we use the SLAM trajectory provided with the dataset. We obtain the camera-to-world transform T t w T_{t}^{w} of each frame by composing the headset pose with the camera-to-headset extrinsics. To detect frames with inaccurate poses, we back-project background pixels outside the GMOS masks to 3D with the stereo depth and project them into frames at least one second away. A projection is inconsistent if it lies in front of the observed surface or falls inside an object mask. Frames with an unusually high fraction of inconsistent projections are marked unreliable and excluded from annotation.
blocks.zh: 我们把20英尺的原始视频 修正到10英尺 对于相机姿势,我们使用提供数据集的SLAM轨迹. 我们通过将相机的相机姿势与相机对相机的相机相接而获得每个相框的相机对相机的变换Ttw T_{t}^{t}^{w}w}. 为了检测不准确的姿势的帧,我们在GMOS口罩外的后期投放背景像素到立体深度为3D并投射到至少一秒外的帧. 如果投影位于被观测到的表面前方或落入物体口罩内,则投影不一致. 不一致的预测比例异常高的框架是不可靠的,被排除在注释之外。

blocks.en: Table S13: Depth calibration accuracy on Xperience-10M. Median relative depth error (%) over all recordings, measured against held-out SLAM landmarks. Positive values indicate overestimated depth.
blocks.zh: 表S13:Xperience-10M上的深度校正精度. 对所有录音的相对深度误差(%),以被搁置的 SAM 地标衡量。 正值表示高估深度.

blocks.en: We find that the stereo depth provided with Xperience-10M systematically overestimates distance, and the error grows with distance. The bias differs across recordings and is consistent with imperfect rectification of the stereo pair. Such errors perturb the disparity, which is inversely proportional to depth. We therefore correct the stereo depth d d of each recording with an affine model in inverse depth, 1 z = a d + b , \frac{1}{z}=\frac{a}{d}+b, (3) where z z is the corrected depth. We fit a a and b b to sparse 3D points that do not rely on the stereo depth: points triangulated from Kanade–Lucas–Tomasi (KLT) tracks [ 52 ] with the SLAM poses, and the SLAM landmarks provided with the dataset. We use half of these points for fitting and hold out the other half for evaluation. On the held-out landmarks, the stereo depth overestimates distance by 1–2% within 1 m and by 7% at 1.5–3 m, with a quarter of the recordings exceeding 16% (Tab. S13 ). After calibration, the median error stays within ± \pm 1% in every depth range up to 3 m, and the held-out KLT points give consistent results.
blocks.zh: 我们发现Xperience-10M提供的立体深度系统地高估了距离,而误差随着距离的增加而增加. 不同录音的偏差不一,与立体对音的不完美纠正一致. 这种错误破坏了差距,与深度成反比。 因此,我们用反向深度的affine模型纠正了每次录音的立体深度d, 1 z = a d + b,\frac{1}{z}=\frac{a}{d}+b, (3)其中z z为正深. 我们把一个a和b 配为不依赖立体深度的稀有3D点: 由 Kanade-Lucas-Tomasi (KLT) 轨迹所分取的点 [52] 与 SLAM 相接, SLAM 地标提供了数据集。 我们用其中一半来配对,用另一半来评价。 在被搁置的地标上,立体深度在1米以内高估了1-2%的距离,在1.5至3米以内高估了7%的距离,四分之一的录音超过16%(Tab. S13 ). 校正后,中值误差会停留在 ±\pm 1% 以内,每个深度范围可达 3 m,被搁置的 KLT 点会给出一致的结果.

blocks.en: We take every third frame of the Aria RGB video to obtain 10 fps and undistort each fisheye frame to a 512 × 512 512\times 512 pinhole image. Camera poses come from the MPS closed-loop trajectory [ 25 ] . Since Ego-Exo4D provides no dense depth, we combine monocular metric depth from MoGe-3 [ 44 ] , stereo depth from FoundationStereo [ 95 ] on two stereo pairs of Aria cameras, and the semi-dense MPS points. For static regions, we correct the monocular depth in inverse depth as in the Xperience-10M calibration (Eq. 3 ), but fit the correction separately for each frame to the MPS points visible in it. For moving objects, which the MPS points do not cover, we rescale the monocular depth to match nearby stereo depth and refine the depth along each point track by optimizing stereo, multi-view photometric, motion smoothness, and monocular prior terms.
blocks.zh: 我们把Aria RGB的每三帧视频 获得10个FPS和undstost 每条鱼眼框架 512×512 512\times 512针孔图像。 相机姿势来自MPS闭路轨 [25]. 由于Ego-Exo4D提供不密集的深度,我们结合了MoGe-3[44]的单相干度量衡深度,从FoundationStereo[95]的立体深度在两对相机上,以及半相干MPS点. 对于静态区域,我们像Xperience-10M校正(Eq. 3)那样修正了反向深度的单相向深度,但将每个帧的校正分别与其中可见的MPS点相匹配. 对于MPS点没有覆盖的移动对象,我们调整了单相位深度,以匹配相邻的立体深度并精炼出沿每个点轨的深度,通过优化立体,多视光度,运动平滑度,和单相位前术语.

blocks.en: We discard low-confidence stereo depth, depth near object boundaries, and depth outside 0.15–3.5 m. For both sources, we fuse the static scene of each recording with TSDF fusion [ 14 ] . We treat pixels outside objects that move during the recording as static and integrate their depth from all frames with reliable poses into a single volume. We then render the fused surface into each frame and use the rendered depth for static pixels, leaving static pixels without a valid fused depth empty. Moving objects, people, and hands keep their per-frame depth. The fused depth reduces per-frame noise, fills small holes, and gives each static point a consistent 3D position across frames.
blocks.zh: 我们抛弃了低自信的立体深度、接近物体边界的深度和0.15-3.5米以外的深度。 对于两个来源,我们把每次录制的静态场景与TSDF聚变[14]相接. 我们把在录制过程中移动的外形物体视为静态,并将它们从所有框架的深度与可靠的外形融合成一卷. 然后,我们把被保险的表面制入每个框架,并使用已变深的静态像素,使静态像素没有有效的被保险的深度。 移动的物体,人,和手 保持他们的每帧深度。 被引信的深度会减少每帧噪声,填入小孔,并给每个静点一个相容的跨帧3D位置.

blocks.en: D.2.2 Motion Segmentation
blocks.zh: D.2.2 动议分离

blocks.en: We obtain object instance masks from GMOS [ 97 ] and label each instance as static or moving in every frame, based on multi-view depth consistency, hand contact, and whether the instance is a person. We detect hand contact from SAM 3.1 hand masks [ 8 ] and, where available, hand motion capture. We label people, and objects whose motion is uncertain, as moving. While an object is out of view, we assume that it remains in place if it was static when it left, unless later frames show that it has moved.
blocks.zh: 我们从 GMOS [97] 获得对象实例口罩,并根据多视图深度一致性,手接方式,以及实例是否为个人,将每个实例标为静态或移动在每个框架. 我们探测到来自SAM 3.1手面具的手相接器[8],并在有可用的情况下进行手动捕捉. 我们把运动不定的人和物体贴上移动的标签。 当一个物体脱离视线时,我们假设如果它离开时是静态的,除非后来的帧显示它已经移动了,否则它仍然存在.

blocks.en: D.2.3 Surface Trajectories
blocks.zh: D.2.3 地表轨道

blocks.en: We obtain trajectories for static surfaces from scene geometry, for moving objects from point tracking, and for hands from motion capture.
blocks.zh: 我们从场景几何获得静态地表的轨迹, 从点追踪移动物体的轨迹, 以及从运动捕捉手的轨迹。

blocks.en: For static surfaces, we project each 3D point of the fused scene into every frame with the camera poses. We mark a static point visible in a frame when its projected depth matches the depth map.
blocks.zh: 对于静态表面,我们将被熔接的场景的每一个3D点投射到每个相框中,并有相机的姿势. 我们标出一个在框架内可见的静态点,当其预测深度与深度图相匹配。

blocks.en: We track points on moving instances with AllTracker [ 35 ] and sample new query points when the existing tracks no longer cover the instance. We sample no query points on hands. Each AllTracker run covers at most 5 s before and 10 s after its query frame. AllTracker also predicts a visibility and a confidence score for each point, and a point is visible when its visibility is at least 0.5. We keep a visible point only if its confidence is at least 0.5 and it lies on its own object mask, has valid depth, and is not on a hand, so that a track does not jump onto an occluding hand. Otherwise, we keep its 2D position but mark it invalid. Depth errors, for example on transparent surfaces, can make a static object appear to move. We therefore also triangulate the tracks of moving objects from the camera poses alone, without depth. If an object’s tracks over frames labeled as moving triangulate to fixed 3D points with a reprojection error of at most 3 pixels, the object is in fact static in these frames, and we relabel them as static. If the depth in these frames differs from the triangulated depth by more than 10%, we use the triangulated points as the 3D positions, and frames without a triangulated point have no 3D position.
blocks.zh: 我们用 AllTracker [35] 追踪移动实例的点, 并对现有轨道不再覆盖实例时, 进行新查询点的样本 。 手头没有查询点 AllTracker运行时最多覆盖了5 s在它的查询框架前和10 s. AllTracker还预测了每个点的能见度和信心分数,当一个点的能见度至少为0.5. 我们只保留一个可见点,只要它的置信度至少为0.5,并且它位于它自己的物体口罩上,有有效的深度,而不是在一只手上,这样一道道就不会跳到被吞噬的手上. 否则,我们保留它的2D位置,但标记无效. 深度错误,比如在透明的表面,可以使一个静态物体看起来移动. 因此,我们还对摄影机上移动物体的轨迹进行三角测量,没有深度。 如果一个物体的轨迹被标注为移动三角到固定的三维点,且重投射出最多为3像素的误差,则该物体实际上在这些帧中是静态的,我们把它们重新贴上静态的标签. 如果这些框架的深度与三角深度相差超过10%,我们用三角点作为3D位置,而没有三角点的框架没有3D位置.

blocks.en: We fit MANO [ 74 ] meshes to the hand motion capture, whose 778 vertices per hand give exact correspondences over time. We project the vertices into each frame and compare them with the depth map to label each vertex as visible, occluded, self-occluded, or inconsistent with the depth. Frames without motion capture have no hand annotations.
blocks.zh: 我们把MANO [74] meshes 与手动抓取, 他们的778个顶点 每手给出准确的对应时间。 我们把顶点投射到每个相框中,并与深度图相提并论,将每个顶点标注为能见度,被渗透度,自蔽度,或与深度不一致. 没有动作抓取的框架没有手语说明.

blocks.en: D.2.4 Reconnecting Reappearing Points
blocks.zh: D.2.4 重新连接再出现点

blocks.en: Figure S14: More point reconnections after reappearance. Two further Xperience-10M sequences in the layout of Fig. 9 . From left to right, the columns show the query points, their tracks shortly before the exit, a frame in which they are out of view (dimmed), and the predictions of AgenTAP and AllTracker after the return. Colors denote point identity. Points predicted invisible are omitted, and each prediction panel reports how many of the ten query points are predicted visible. The arrow gives the time between exit and re-entry.
blocks.zh: 图S14: 复出后多点再接. 在图9的布局中,又有两个Xperience-10M序列. 从左到右,列会显示查询点,出站前不久的出站轨迹,出站框(dimmed),返回后AgenTAP和AllTracker的预测. 颜色表示点身份。 所预测的隐形点被省略,每个预测面板都报告十个查询点中有多少是可被预测的. 箭头给出出站后再入站间的时间.

blocks.en: After an object leaves the field of view, GMOS sometimes assigns its instance identity to a different object that appears later. Before reconnecting tracks, we show GPT-6.1 Sol the object before and after the gap and ask whether it is the same object. If it is not, we give the later mask a new instance identity.
blocks.zh: 在对象离开视野后,GMOS有时会将其实例身份指定给后来出现的不同的对象. 在重新连接音轨之前, 我们显示 GPT-6.1 。 解析空白前后的对象并询问是否为同一对象. 如果不是,我们给后面的面具 一个新的实例身份。

blocks.en: When an object or a person leaves the field of view and returns, we try to continue its existing tracks after the gap. We bridge gaps of up to one second with AllTracker and keep a bridge when its forward–backward error is at most 3 pixels. By design, we leave gaps between one and three seconds unconnected and use the VLM for longer ones.
blocks.zh: 当一个物体或一个人离开视野并返回时,我们试图在缺口后继续其已存在的轨道. 我们用AllTracker来弥补一秒钟的缺口, 并保留一个桥, 当它的后向错误最多为3像素时。 设计上,我们留下一至三秒的空档,没有连接,用VLM来做更长的空档.

blocks.en: For gaps of at least three seconds, we ask AgenTAP with GPT-6 Astra to locate 10 query points from before the gap in several frames after the object returns (Fig. 9 and Fig. S14 ). The query points are the object’s existing tracks or textured points that we sample in the last frame before the gap in which the object is large enough. Each image pair shows the frame of the query points and one frame after the return. Sharing one session among several points keeps accuracy and lowers token usage (Sec. C.4 ). We do not query the VLM when the object is static on both sides of the gap, stays in view for less than one second after returning, or never appears large enough to sample query points. Of the 14,091 image pairs with 10 points each, 7,057 pass filtering, with 70,570 query points. Of these points, 23,072 pass the checks below and enter the dataset.
blocks.zh: 对于至少3秒的空隙,我们请带有GPT-6 Astra的AgenTAP在对象返回后数个框架(图9和图S14)中从空隙前找到10个查询点. 查询点是对象已存在的音轨或有纹理的点,我们在对象足够大的空隙之前的最后一个框中加以取样. 每个图像对显示查询点的框和返回后的一个框. 在几个点之间共享一个会话保持准确性并降低符号使用率(Sec.C.4.)。 当对象在空隙两侧为静态时,我们不查询VLM,在返回后停留一秒内视线,或者永远不显示足够样本查询点. 在14,091个图像对中,每对10分,有7,057个通过过滤,有70,570个查询点. 在这些点中,23,072个通过下面的检查并输入数据集.

blocks.en: We accept a VLM prediction only if the VLM finds the queried point and the prediction lies on the same object, has valid depth, and is not on a hand. We then track each accepted prediction with AllTracker to a second frame after the return and compare it with the VLM prediction in that frame. Matching predictions verify the reconnection, and conflicting ones are rejected. Predictions that cannot be cross-checked are kept but marked unverified. We do not fill in positions during the gap.
blocks.zh: 我们只接受VLM的预测,前提是VLM找到被询问的点,并且预测位于同一个物体上,有有效的深度,而不是手. 然后我们用AllTracker追踪每个被接受的预测到返回后的第二个帧,并与该帧中的VLM预测进行比较. 匹配的预测验证了重联,相冲突者被拒绝. 无法交叉检查的预测保留下来,但没有经过核实。 我们不填补空缺期间的职位。

blocks.en: D.2.5 3D Lifting, Filtering, and Annotation Format
blocks.zh: D.2.5 三维起重、过滤和注释格式

blocks.en: We back-project every valid track point to 3D with Eq. 2 . Stereo noise can make a back-projected point jump along the viewing ray. We invalidate the 3D position of a track in frames where it spikes or deviates from its neighboring frames along the ray by more than 2 cm or 4% of its distance, whichever is larger, while keeping its 2D position. When at least half of an object’s tracks jump in the same frame, we discard the depth of the entire object in that frame.
blocks.zh: 我们用Eq. 2来回投射每个有效的轨迹 立体声可以使后投影点沿取景光跳出. 我们取消了一个轨迹在相框中的三维位置,如果轨迹沿着射线在相框上悬浮或偏离相框2厘米或相距4%以上,以两者中较大者为准,同时保留其二维位置。 当一个物体的轨道至少有一半跳入同一个框架时,我们就丢弃这个框架内整个物体的深度.

blocks.en: Each track stores its 2D and 3D positions, object instance, temporal segments, per-frame visibility state, and annotation source. The source indicates whether a position comes from AllTracker, a short-gap bridge, a verified or unverified VLM reconnection, or triangulation. The visibility state is one of visible, masked, occluded, out of frame, object absent, or position missing. A point may have a valid 2D position but no valid 3D position.
blocks.zh: 每个音轨存储其2D和3D位置,对象实例,时间段,每个帧的能见度状态,以及注释源. 来源表示一个位置是否来自AllTracker,一个短相桥,一个经过核实或未经核实的VLM重接,或者三角. 能见度状态是可见,被蒙蔽,被被占有,出相框,物体缺失,或位置缺失等一种. 一个点可能有一个有效的2D位置,但没有有效的3D位置.

blocks.en: D.3 Annotation Quality
blocks.zh: D.3 注释质量

blocks.en: Fig. 9 of the main paper and Fig. S14 compare how AgenTAP and AllTracker locate ten query points after an object or a person returns to the field of view. Fig. 8 of the main paper shows 3D trajectories from six recordings in world coordinates, together with the corresponding 2D trajectories in the video frames.
blocks.zh: 主纸的图9和Fig. S14比较AgenTAP和AllTracker在物体或人返回到视野后如何定位十个查询点. 发相. 主论文8从世界坐标的6个录音中显示出3D轨迹,并加上视频帧中相应的2D轨迹.

blocks.en: For the audit in Tab. 5 , we select reappearance events from Xperience-10M in which a rigid object or a person is out of view for at least 3 s and visible for at least 1 s before and after. We leave out deformable and transparent objects. Two annotators label the query points in the first second after the object returns. They work independently and see neither the model predictions nor each other’s labels. Points on people and on moved objects count as dynamic, and the rest as static. The audit has 582 point–frame pairs from 49 events, 428 dynamic from 41 events and 154 static from 8 events. We score each method against both annotators with the benchmark metrics (Sec. A.5 ) and report the average. For the human row, we score one annotator against the other.
blocks.zh: 为了Tab的审计. 5,我们从Xperience-10M中选择一个刚性物体或一个人在至少3 s 的视线外,至少1 s 前后可见的再现事件. 我们只留下变形的透明物体。 在对象返回后的第一秒中有两个标记查询点的注释器. 他们独立工作,既不看模型预测,也不看对方的标签. 对人和被移动物体的指点是动态的,其余是静态的。 审计共有49个事件的582个点-框对,41个事件的428个动态和8个事件的154个静态. 我们用基准衡量标准(Sec.A.5)对两种方法进行评分,并报告平均值。 对于人类排,我们得分 一个注释员对另一个。

blocks.en: D.4 D4RT Training and Evaluation
blocks.zh: D.4 D4RT 培训和评价

blocks.en: Tab. 4 compares our reproduction of D4RT [ 100 ] with and without EgoTAP-4D . Both models use the D4RT architecture and train for 200k steps on 8 nodes, whereas the published D4RT trains for 500k steps on a mixture of public and internal datasets. The baseline uses eight public datasets: Dynamic Replica [ 40 ] , PointOdyssey [ 103 ] , FallingThings [ 88 ] , Kubric [ 31 ] , CO3Dv2 [ 72 ] , TartanAir [ 93 ] , TartanGround [ 61 ] , and Waymo Open [ 81 ] . The second model also uses EgoTAP-4D , and all datasets are sampled with equal weights. The added-data run uses all annotation sources, including VLM reconnections, with supervision restricted to valid image, visibility, and 3D targets.
blocks.zh: Tab. 4将我们复制的D4RT[100]与EgoTAP-4D相比. 两种车型都使用D4RT架构并用在8个节点上的200k级出行列车,而已公布的D4RT列车则用公有和内部数据集混合的500k级出行. 基线使用8个公共数据集:动态复制 [40],PointOdyssey [103],FallingThings [88],Kubric [31],CO3Dv2 [72],TartanAir [93],TartanGround [61],和Waymo Open [81]. 第二个模型还使用了EgoTAP-4D ,所有数据集都采用等重的样本. 添加数据运行使用所有注释来源,包括VLM重联,监管仅限于有效图像,能见度,和3D目标.

blocks.en: Evaluation covers Aria Digital Twin (ADT) and PStudio from TAPVid-3D [ 45 ] , DexYCB [ 9 ] , and DROID [ 43 ] . For DexYCB, we sample points on the annotated object meshes. For DROID, we sample points on the robot, whose 3D pose follows from its joint angles. We report AJ, APD 3 ​ D \mathrm{APD}_{\mathrm{3D}} , and OA as defined in TAPVid-3D, separately for each dataset. Overall is the unweighted arithmetic mean of the four dataset scores, so larger evaluation sets do not dominate the aggregate. Adding EgoTAP-4D improves all three aggregate metrics. Localization improves on ADT, PStudio, and DROID, while DexYCB has lower AJ and APD 3 ​ D \mathrm{APD}_{\mathrm{3D}} despite improved visibility.
blocks.zh: 评价范围 Aria Digital Twin (ADT) and PStudio from TAPVid-3D [45], DexYCB [9], 和 DROID [43]. 对于DexYCB, 我们在注释对象中间点上取出样本. 对于DROID来说,我们在机器人上取样,它的3D姿势从它的关节角度来进行. 我们报告 AJ,APD 3 D\mathrm{APD}_{\ mathrm{3D}}},以及TAPVid-3D定义的OA,分别针对每个数据集. 总体而言,四套数据集分数的未加权算法平均值,因此较大的评价集并不支配总量. 加入"EgoTAP-4D"可以改进所有三个汇总度量. 本地化在ADT,PStudio,和DROID上有所改进,而DexYCB则拥有更低的AJ和APD 3 D\mathrm{APD}_{\mathrm{3D}},尽管知名度得到提高.
